author: samazzo
body:
So, on 13th September 2014 at 11:28 GMT, i was playing nebula with my friends and my game was lagging and glitching so my friends told me relog maybe it goes, so i relogged and it still lagged and glithched so i still played but at a point my game froze while i was in the air and there was Mango_ in the lobby and he thought that i was fly hacking (which i was not)
.I closed down minecraft and reopened it and when i went to login in your server i got banned 
my username is samazzo and i hope you guys unban me for the misunderstanding
